title: Vista Del Mar Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Stunning grand corner lot home on Seaside Avenue with two expansive open air furnished front porches, out door dining, and a tower w/stunning Gulf and sunset views! Four bedrooms w/private baths! Just steps to the beach.
description_expanded: Description100 SEASIDE AVENUE2 KINGS, 1 QUEENS, 2 TWINS *PET FRIENDLYPrime Seaside Location on Iconic Seaside AvenueMake lasting memories at Vista del Mar, a beloved Seaside family favorite perfectly positioned on a prime corner lot along the tree-lined and stately Seaside Avenue. This grand plantation-style home offers a true Seasider experience, featuring two expansive front porches spanning the length of the home and a three-tier rear tower with breathtaking sunset views toward the Gulf of Mexico and postcard-worthy views of Seaside’s colorful cottages.Grand Outdoor Living & Welcoming First ImpressionsFrom the moment you arrive, Vista del Mar impresses with its classic Southern architecture and an expansive open-air front porch filled with lounge seating and a charming swing. The porch overlooks a private, fenced front yard and Seaside Avenue—perfect for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or evening conversations under the trees.Spacious First Floor Living & EntertainingStep through the entry foyer to discover a thoughtfully designed first floor ideal for gathering and relaxation. To the right, a spacious living room with a flat-screen TV flows seamlessly into an open wine bar and fully equipped kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances and everything needed for family meals or entertaining.Nearby, the indoor dining area seats six, while an adjacent screened-in porch offers outdoor dining for eight, blending indoor comfort with coastal breezes. Toward the rear of the home, a second living room with a flat-screen TV provides a separate space—perfect for multiple activities or quiet downtime. Completing the first floor is a comfortable king bedroom with a private en suite bathroom, ideal for guests seeking main-level accommodations.Second Floor Bedrooms & Expansive PorchesThe second floor features three additional bedrooms, each with its own private bath. Two guest bedrooms—one with a queen bed and one with two twin beds—share access to the large second-story front porch overlooking Seaside Avenue. This porch is beautifully furnished with chairs, a swing, and a table for four, making it a favorite spot for card games, puzzles, or post-beach relaxation.Luxurious Primary Suite RetreatThe nearly 600-square-foot primary suite is a true sanctuary, showcasing a king canopy bed, a cozy seating area for reading or TV viewing, and a spacious walk-in closet. The spa-inspired primary bathroom includes dual vanities, a whirlpool soaking tub, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with a rain shower head.What truly sets this suite apart is its private porch, complete with a loveseat swing, outdoor dining for two, and rocking chairs—an intimate space to unwind in total privacy.Three-Tier Tower with Sunset & Rooftop ViewsA spiral staircase leads to the top of Vista del Mar’s three-tier tower, where a hammock and seating await. From here, enjoy stunning sunset views down East Ruskin, panoramic rooftop vistas across downtown Seaside, and sweeping views of the town’s iconic pastel cottages. It’s the perfect spot for evening cocktails, stargazing, or simply soaking in the magic of Seaside.A True Seasider ExperienceWith its prime location, expansive porches, multiple living spaces, and unforgettable views, Vista del Mar delivers everything you crave in a Seaside vacation home. There is truly no better place to stay if you’re looking to experience the charm, beauty, and relaxed elegance of Seaside, Florida.*Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $50 a day rental pet fee will be collected in addition to the flat $275 pet fee. Pets will not be allowed on the furniture. No pets over 70 lbs.For additional room, the one-bedroom guest house, Carriage House, may also be rented.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, & Summer; 3 nights Fall; 2 nights Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. * Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $100 per day rental pet fee will be collected, in addition to the flat $175 pet fee, for four-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture.FEATURESPrime corner location at Seaside Avenue and East Ruskin3,098 square feet of interior living space, plus 1,600 square feet of expansive outdoor porch spaceFour spacious bedrooms, each with a private en suite bath, and two comfortable living roomsPrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion3-minute, 176-yard walk to beach accessThree-story tower offering stunning panoramic views of Seaside in every directionWasher and dryer conveniently located in the homePeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for this home. A golf cart is considered a vehicle; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners. Special circumstances and medical needs require an approved golf cart permitSTR23-002358
